description:
Get a verified coin's creator record

The creator record of a verified coin: how many coins its creator launched before, how many are still trading and how many died within a week, when they first launched, how old the wallet is and who funded it, plus what the creator has done with this coin since (events) and "Bundled at open". Every label comes with its one-line definition. Read from chains and kept by Chain Daddy; the answer never calls a third party, so it can lag the chain by up to a day. `state` is `pending` until the record is first computed, and `offPlatformPending` stays `true` while launches on other platforms are still being read. Answers 404 for a ticker with no verified page on that chain, for a page Chain Daddy removed, and everywhere while the creator record is off. Keyless, the same for every caller, and cached for about a minute.

chain.description: Chain key, lowercase, as in the page's own address (e.g. `base`, `solana`). A numeric chain ID answers 404.

symbol.description: The coin's ticker (letters and digits, any case)

name: get_creator_record

outputSchema.description:
A coin creator's record, as Chain Daddy reads it from chains. Facts and counts only; every label
carries its definition.

definitions.description: The one-line definition of each word the record uses, by key

events.description: What the creator did with this coin, newest first

kind.description:
`sell` (into the coin's pool), `moved_out` (to any other wallet), `creator_exited` (holds 10% or
less of what they launched with). Counts only the creator's own wallets.

funderLabel.description: Who first funded the creator's wallet, when the funder is a known operator (e.g. an exchange)

holdings.description: What the creator holds of this coin. Absent until the coin is watched (it traded in the last 7 days).

launchPctSupply.description: Percent of supply they held at the watch's first reading of the coin

pctSupply.description: Percent of supply the creator's own wallets hold

team.description: Wallets the creator named (team, fee, fee sharers), shown apart

identity.description: What the creator proved about who they are. Absent when nothing is proved.

coinbaseVerified.description:
The creator's wallet holds Coinbase's "Verified Account" attestation on Base, as last
checked by the creator. Absent when not.

x.description: The creator's verified X account and the month it was created

definition.description: The label's one line, built from this coin's facts

launchesAlive.description: Of those, how many still trade

launchesDead7d.description: Of those, how many stopped trading within 7 days of launch

launchesTotal.description: Coins this creator launched, here and on other platforms

offPlatformPending.description: Launches on other platforms are still being read; counts may grow

openBlock.description: "Bundled at open": who bought in the coin's opening blocks (EVM: the launch block and the next 3; Solana: the first 30 slots). Absent when the opening blocks were not seen.

bundledPct.description: Percent of supply bought in the opening blocks by wallets buying 3 or more to a block

bundledWallets.description: How many wallets bought in those blocks

buyers.description: Wallets that bought in the opening blocks

creatorLinkedPct.description: Percent of supply bought in the opening blocks by wallets linked to the creator (wallets the creator controls, or funded by the creator or the creator's funder)

linkedPending.description: Links between the buyers and the creator are still being read

linkedWallets.description: How many opening buyers are linked to the creator

promoters.description:
Wallets this coin pays a share of its creator fees to (paid promotion), each with its record
from launches here. Omitted when the coin pays none. Not part of the block rule.

handle.description: Shown only when the promoter verified it

ownLaunches.description: Coins the promoter launched themselves, when any

paidLaunches.description: Launches here that paid them a share

sharePct.description: The share of the creator's fees this coin pays them, in percent

stillTrading.description: Of those, how many still trade

stoppedWithin7d.description: Of those, how many stopped trading within 7 days of launch

state.description:
`pending` (not read yet), `first_launch` (no earlier launch found), `on_record` (earlier
launches found), `serial` (many launches, most dead within a week) or `blocked` (refused new
launches here).

title: Get a coin's creator record
